court_design.c1_suite_derivation: The accepted C1 return records only the per-file profile 92/35/32/17/14/13/13/8/3/2/43/57/54/43/28 = 454, not the filenames. The 15 filenames were reconstructed from the filesystem and then CONSTRAINED by that profile. The reconstruction is unique: it matches the accepted multiset exactly and sums to exactly 454.
court_design.c3_surface_derivation: The three pinned C3 court files are the complete G01/D01/D02 source-free surface named in the commission.
court_design.c3_compat_derivation: Computed mechanically, not by judgement: every test file importing any of the three C3-owned modules (closed35_g01_sav_numeric_representation_authority, pre553_physical_decoder, pre553_r5_codec). These are the unchanged compatibility dependencies required by C3's accepted court.
court_design.path_assertion_before_execution: Every listed path was asserted to exist as a file before any execution. missing=0.

ModuleNotFoundError: pandas at collection. Imports pandas AND drives pre553_c11_ingest / pre553_c11_repository, i.e. the C11 raw-ingest surface.
ModuleNotFoundError: pandas at collection. Imports pandas AND pyreadstat, which is the raw statistical-file reader.

exclusion_justification: All five fail at COLLECTION on a missing third-party dependency, so none can execute in the declared source-free runtime. Two of them additionally sit on the raw C11 ingest / pyreadstat surface, which is outside lane A by the no-raw-access rule even if pandas were present. The commission asks for the complete APPLICABLE source-free surface; these five are not applicable at this grain. They are reported here rather than silently dropped, and installing pandas was deliberately not attempted because two of them are raw-facing and therefore outside this lane regardless.

c3_result_on_combined_tree.note: Runtime is the consolidated run's contribution; the isolated C3-parent comparison run is recorded in 04_EXECUTION_RECEIPT.json.

failures_and_triage.triage_method: Each failing file was executed against BOTH accepted parents in separate detached worktrees. A merge-induced regression would appear only on the combined tree; an inherited failure appears on the parents too.

failures_and_triage.conclusion: The C3 subset reproduces the accepted C3 result EXACTLY (76 passed / 3 failed), and the 3 failures are identical at both accepted parents. The merge introduced zero new failures and resolved none. These 3 are pre-existing failed evidence in the repository, consistent with the accepted C1 record's own retained item 'Historical failed evidence: 434 passed / 1 failed remains historical failed evidence and is not relabelled.'
failures_and_triage.scope_honesty: This lane does not claim a zero-failure court. It claims that the combined tree reproduces both accepted courts exactly and adds no new failure.

source_free_attestation.note: No hashing or metadata probe against any survey file was performed. The five excluded files were excluded on a module-import observation (pandas / pyreadstat), not by inspecting survey material.
